feature: Customer Portal (artifacts/portal) -- SOPs & Runbooks (/sops, /runbooks), wired to real data (#2994, carried forward from #1730/#1493/#1488). /runbooks was rebuilt for #4006 (2026-09-14) against the real standalone design Design/portal/design_handoff_full_site/screens/Runbooks.dc.html -- Shane's reversal of the joint #1488/#1493 'fold into SOPs' decision. /sops still uses SOPs.dc.html. Real endpoints: GET/POST /api/portal/sops, GET /api/portal/sop-runs, POST /api/portal/sops/:sopId/custom-steps (routes/portal-sops.ts, requireRole('Customer')), and GET /api/portal/runbooks + the hold-window writes (routes/portal-runbooks.ts, requireRole('Assessment')) via useRunbooks.ts (#1557 cycle/run-history shape). No fixture data anywhere -- a genuinely empty runbooks/holds table for this tenant renders the design's own honest-empty copy, not a fabricated row.
notes: artifacts/msp-portal (the old '/portal-v2/*' surface, including test-manifests/portal/portal-v2-sops.json) was retired for artifacts/portal in f40438cdc (#1921). This manifest covers the REPLACEMENT pages at the new, un-slugged routes /portal/sops and /portal/runbooks -- it is not an update of portal-v2-sops.json, which tests a page that no longer exists in the tree.

Real login (#2991, Feature #1648) landed in artifacts/portal concurrently with this build -- /portal/login, data-testid login-email/login-password/login-submit, POST /api/auth/login under the hood. The uiSteps below drive that real form rather than asserting only the unauthenticated RequireAuth gate. The testbed account (TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL) has no MFA enrolled, so login navigates straight to '/' with no MFA phase.

apiTests below ARE fully authenticated (via the real POST /api/auth/login + Bearer token, same as every other portal manifest) and were hand-verified live against this environment before being written: GET /api/portal/sops returned 15 real msp_sops rows for the testbed account (customerId 1), GET /api/portal/sop-runs returned an empty queue + 15 real 'Version published' audit rows, GET /api/portal/runbooks returned a genuinely empty {runbooks:[],holds:[],summary:{...,text:'No hold windows'}} for this tenant (0 rows in portal_runbooks/portal_hold_windows at verification time -- a live-empty state, not a bug), and both POST /api/portal/sops and POST /api/portal/sops/:sopId/custom-steps were exercised for real and their written rows re-read back correctly shaped.

A3c/A3d create a real 'ours'-source SOP row and a real custom-step overlay row on it, same pattern portal-v2-sops.json's own A3c/A3d used -- these are additive, idempotent-safe re-runs (a fresh row each time, never deleted), not destructive.

#4006 REDESIGN NOTE: /runbooks moved from the old 'Active Runbooks' single-stack layout to the design's master-detail layout (list + selected-runbook detail, past-cycle history, hold-window event timeline, a 'what this page deliberately does not do' ledger). The honest-empty copy changed from the old page's 'No active runbooks' to the new design's literal 'No runbooks yet' -- U9 below asserts the new real string. The stale sibling manifest test-manifests/portal/runbooks-hold-windows.json targets retired portal-v2 slug-scoped routes that no longer exist in the tree (see the finding filed against #1488) and is not touched by this build.

sessionTag: the login flow (goto /portal/login through the primary-login click) carries sessionTag 'setup' so it always runs under an onlyTag-scoped invocation; the #4006 runbooks assertions carry sessionTag '4006-runbooks-redesign' for scoped re-verification (`shaneapp://runTest?file=sops-runbooks.json&onlyTag=4006-runbooks-redesign`).
ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.
